files.module_doc:
UnaMentis - Knowledge Bowl Audio Cache
Client-side cache for pre-generated TTS audio from the server
Fetches and caches audio for KB questions to achieve zero-latency
playback during practice sessions.

UnaMentis - Knowledge Bowl Question Service
Manages loading and filtering questions for practice sessions
Questions are loaded from the bundled file first for immediate availability,
then optionally synced from the server in the background.

UnaMentis - Knowledge Bowl Stats Manager
Persists and tracks practice session statistics
Stores domain mastery, session history, and aggregate stats
using UserDefaults for simplicity.

UnaMentis - Knowledge Bowl Voice Coordinator
Handles voice-first integration for practice sessions
Automatically speaks questions via TTS and listens for
verbal answers via STT, working alongside the text UI.
